description: The line plot illustrates the time cost (in seconds) as a function of paper number, comparing two methods: “w/o Pre-computation” (blue line) and an unnamed baseline (orange line). The x-axis, labeled “Paper Number,” spans from 1 to 256 on a linear scale, with tick marks at powers of two (1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32, 64, 128, 256). The y-axis, labeled “Time Cost (s),” ranges from 0 to 35 seconds, with major ticks every 5 seconds. The blue line (“w/o Pre-computation”) starts near 0.5 seconds at Paper Number 1, rises gradually to about 3 seconds at Paper Number 32, then steeply increases to approximately 9 seconds at 64, 20 seconds at 128, and reaches 35 seconds at 256. In contrast, the orange line remains nearly flat across the entire range, staying consistently below 1 second — approximately 0.5 seconds at Paper Number 1 and 0.6 seconds at 256 — indicating negligible growth in time cost. The legend is positioned in the upper left corner, with the blue line labeled “w/o Pre-computation” and the orange line unlabeled but visually distinct.
